channel.title: Bangu Kwetu
channel.description: Independent news covering Eastlands, Nairobi — Kariobangi North, Dandora, Embakasi North, and Outering.

item.title: 90-Day Window Opens for Foreign Traders to Regularise in Kenya
item.description: Foreign traders in Kenya have 90 days to regularise immigration, business and work documents before stricter enforcement begins.

item.title: Ruto Signs Four Bills, Changing Rules on Kenya's Public Finances and Trusts
item.description: President Ruto has signed four Bills into law, introducing new rules on public finance, air passenger charges, population planning and trusts.

item.title: Kenya Targets 800,000 Tonnes of Sugar Production in 2026
item.description: Kenya is targeting 800,000 tonnes of sugar production in 2026 as the government pushes to strengthen local supply and reduce reliance on imports.

item.title: KURA Announces Three-Hour Outer Ring Road Closure This Saturday
item.description: Nairobi motorists will face disruption on Outer Ring Road this Saturday as KURA removes an overhead gantry near Airport North Road.

item.title: FKF Meets Clubs as 2026/27 League Start Remains Uncertain
item.description: FKF held talks with clubs on September 2 as Kenya's 2026/27 top-flight season remains affected by a dispute over league rules.

item.title: Kenya Investors Question Sh5 Billion SEZ Investment Threshold
item.description: Investors question Kenya's Sh5 billion SEZ threshold, warning it could lock smaller businesses out of long-term licences.

item.title: Government Releases KSh850 Million Cash Support for Vulnerable Families
item.description: The government has released KSh850.7 million to support more than 425,000 households caring for orphans and vulnerable children.

item.title: Court Told Key Nairobi CCTV Cameras Were Offline During Rex Masai Shooting
item.description: An inquest has heard that key Nairobi CBD CCTV cameras were offline during the 2024 shooting of protester Rex Masai.

item.title: Kenya Airways Acting CEO George Kamal Resigns
item.description: Kenya Airways Acting CEO George Kamal has resigned, with Habil Waswani set to take over in an acting capacity from September 15.

item.title: Omanyala Ends 2026 Season Early After Heel Injury
item.description: Ferdinand Omanyala has ended his 2026 season after a stress fracture ruled him out of the Diamond League Final and Ultimate Championship.

item.title: Principals Warn Funding Shortfall Could Disrupt Learning in Schools
item.description: Secondary school principals warn that a capitation funding shortfall could disrupt learning as schools begin the third term

item.title: Kenya Inflation Rises to 6.6% as Food and Transport Costs Climb
item.description: Kenya's inflation rose to 6.6% in August as higher food, transport and housing costs added pressure to household budgets.

item.title: CA Proposes New Safeguards for Recycling Inactive Mobile Numbers
item.description: The Communications Authority has proposed safeguards for inactive mobile numbers as Kenyans are invited to submit public views.

item.title: JKIA Flights Resume After Aviation Workers Call Off Strike
item.description: JKIA operations are resuming after aviation workers called off their strike, with efforts underway to clear disrupted flights.

item.title: Rising Stars Draw South Sudan and Burundi in U-20 Qualifiers
item.description: Kenya's Rising Stars will face South Sudan and Burundi in Group C of the 2026 CECAFA U-20 AFCON qualifiers.

item.title: Emergency Jet Fuel Import Helps Avert Shortage at Kenya's Major Airports
item.description: Kenya brought in emergency jet fuel to prevent shortages at JKIA and Moi Airport as rising demand put supplies under pressure.

item.title: Kenya Police Bullets Miss CAF Ticket After Extra-Time Final Defeat
item.description: Kenya Police Bullets lost 1-0 to Kawempe Muslim after extra time, missing out on the CAF Women's Champions League.

item.title: Kenya Railways Adds Special Trains as Aviation Disruptions Continue
item.description: Kenya Railways has added special Nairobi–Mombasa services, giving travellers more options as aviation disruptions continue.

item.title: KUCCPS Reopens KMTC Applications, Giving Students Another Chance
item.description: KUCCPS has reopened applications for selected KMTC programmes, giving eligible students another chance to join the September 2026 intake.

item.title: Milk Supply Pressure Raises Price Concerns as COFEK Calls for Action
item.description: Falling formal milk supplies have raised price concerns as COFEK gives the government seven days to outline urgent action.

item.title: Stolen Phone Leads Police to Suspected Nairobi Handset Network
item.description: A stolen phone led police to a Nairobi shop where 12 other handsets were recovered as investigations into a suspected network continue.

item.title: Hundreds Remain Stranded at JKIA as Aviation Workers' Strike Continues
item.description: Hundreds of passengers remain stranded at JKIA as an aviation workers' strike enters its second day, disrupting flights and airport operations.

item.title: Kenya Boosts Power Imports as Rising Demand Puts Grid Under Pressure
item.description: Kenya increased electricity imports from Ethiopia and Uganda as rising demand put pressure on local generation and raised concerns over power rationing.

item.title: Kenya Police Bullets Reach CECAFA Final After 5-0 Win Over Yei Joint Stars
item.description: Kenya Police Bullets thrashed Yei Joint Stars 5-0 in Kigali to reach the CECAFA qualifiers final and move closer to CAF Women's Champions League qualification.

item.title: Youth Storm Utimo Sacco Offices Over Death of Man in Matatu Incident
item.description: Youth and community members stormed Utimo Sacco offices in Buruburu, demanding accountability over the death of Brian Wafula.

item.title: Kenyan YouTube Creators Face New 5% Tax Deduction on Earnings
item.description: Kenyan YouTube creators face a new 5% withholding tax on earnings as Google requires AdSense users to submit KRA PIN details.

item.title: Fertiliser Subsidy Programme Loses More Than 426,000 Kenyan Farmers
item.description: More than 426,000 farmers left Kenya's fertiliser subsidy programme in the year to June, raising fresh questions about access to farm inputs.

item.title: Gikomba Market Takes Shape as Nairobi Redevelopment Moves Forward
item.description: Three new multi-storey blocks are taking shape at Gikomba as Nairobi's major market undergoes redevelopment aimed at improving trading and safety.

item.title: From Kitui to Malkia Strikers: Josephine Kataa's Rise Continues
item.description: Josephine Kataa's journey from Kitui to Malkia Strikers highlights the rise of a new generation of Kenyan volleyball talent.

item.title: Kenya Targets 5,500MW Power Capacity in Major Energy Expansion
item.description: Kenya is targeting 5,500MW of power capacity as it expands nuclear, geothermal and hydropower projects to meet rising electricity demand.
